description: Gold test set for the Nimbus corpus. Answers are the CURRENT values. Questions tagged 'stale_trap' have an outdated value present in docs/changelog.md, and separate a pipeline with a working selection step from one without. Questions tagged 'precision_trap' have a correct answer that is a strict subset of a superficially similar fact elsewhere in the corpus, and separate precise retrieval from sloppy retrieval.

questions.question: What is the rate limit for a single API key?
What is the maximum size of a job payload?
How long is a single job attempt allowed to run before it times out?
How many times will Nimbus attempt a job before marking it failed?
What are the possible job states?
What port does a self-hosted Nimbus server listen on by default?
How long are completed jobs retained before being purged?
How do you authenticate a request to the Nimbus API?
questions.answer: Send the API key as a bearer token in the Authorization header

questions.question: How many worker processes run by default on a self-hosted server?
What is the base URL of the hosted API?
What is the base delay for the exponential backoff between retry attempts, before it doubles?
What HTTP method and path do you call to cancel a job?
Which job states are considered terminal (a job in one of these will never change again)?
Besides polling, how can you be notified when a job finishes?
questions.answer: Register a webhook URL; Nimbus POSTs the final job result to it when the job reaches a terminal state
